rationale: Kaarel is a founding ML engineer shipping AI agents and zero-shot matching solutions at a consumer AI startup, while Wang Chuanfu leads BYD — the world's largest EV manufacturer — with deep conviction that technological innovation solves real social problems at scale. Their domains don't overlap directly, but Wang's 60–70% focus on technology and product development, combined with Kaarel's track record of shipping complex ML systems fast, could spark ideas around autonomous vehicle perception, battery optimization, or manufacturing logistics problems that pure research hasn't tackled.
intro_message: Kaarel Kaarelson, meet Wang Chuanfu — a founding ML engineer shipping agentic AI tools and someone building the world's largest EV manufacturer might have unexpected angles on where AI unlocks next-generation vehicle or supply chain problems.
